The negative reaction is attributed to investors' high expectations due to AMD's lofty valuations, which demand an even steeper jump in revenue and guidance to justify its premium compared to competitors like Nvidia. While AMD's Q3 outlook surpassed the mid-point of Wall Street's consensus, it failed to meet the highest estimates, further contributing to the sell-off.
